elaine: Found KMS-wrapped Vault transit ciphertext in partner CI artifacts. Need immediate containment + rotation.

mike: Share sanitized path and sample line.

elaine: gs://partner-ci-logs/prod/2026-03-20/build-891.log
Sample: `2026-03-20T05:10:11Z uploader INFO artifact uploaded: ciphertext:v1:kms:projects/redwood-prod/...`

jordan: Oncall pausing writes to bucket and setting it read-only. Notifying partners.

sam: Revoking CI SA keys and removing logging.writer role now. Commands run.

security-bot: [automated] Created SEC-2026-331; audit export enabled.

mike: Plan: (1) freeze writes (done) (2) revoke keys (done) (3) create new KMS key version (I'll do) (4) Vault transit rewrap (elaine/jordan) (5) rotate tokens (team) (6) add upload redaction + RBAC tighten.

elaine: Running a canary rewrap with Vault transit (non-secret sample). If green, batch in controlled windows.

jordan: Export affected logs to sealed BigQuery dataset with masking. Keep immutable snapshot.

sam: RBAC PR opened to add temporary sealed-log-reader role and incident label incident/ci-ciphertext-2026.

elaine: Canary rewrap succeeded; starting batched rewraps. Will post updates every 10m.

mike: After rotation, run CI dry-run and then unfreeze. Also add detection for ciphertext patterns in artifacts.

elaine: ETA finish containment + rotations ~50m. Thanks everyone for quick response.
